Based on the provided context, here is the comparison of the maximum number of paid sick days for a single extended absence:

**GitLab Canada Corp:**
*   **Maximum Paid Days:** **25 working days** (plus an additional 25 working days for family care if not covered by provincial benefits).
*   **Details:** For extended sick leave of 5+ days, GitLab supplements pay up to 100% of regular salary for up to **25 working days**.

**GitLab PTY Ltd. (New Zealand):**
*   **Maximum Paid Days:** **20 days** (statutory sick leave balance).
*   **Details:** The context states that the **maximum accumulation** of statutory sick leave is **20 days** under New Zealand's Holidays Act 2003. While GitLab's additional sick time policy runs concurrently, the specific statutory cap for sick leave accumulation is 20 days. The context does not specify a separate "top-up" or extended paid period for non-work injuries beyond the use of sick/annual leave for the first week and ACC top-ups (which are for injury, not general sickness). For general statutory sick leave, the limit is the accumulated balance, capped at 20 days.

**Difference:**
The maximum number of paid sick days for a single extended absence is **5 working days higher** at GitLab Canada Corp (25 days) compared to GitLab PTY Ltd. in New Zealand (20 days).

*(Note: The Canadian figure is explicitly stated as "25 working days" for extended leave, while the New Zealand figure is the "maximum accumulation" of 20 days. If the employee has accumulated the full 20 days, that is the maximum they can take as statutory sick leave.)*

Context:
[GitLab PTY Ltd. Benefits - New Zealand > **GitLab PTY Ltd. Benefits - New Zealand** > **Time Away & Leave Policies** > **Statutory Sick Leave**]
Comprehensive sick leave coverage that builds over time, supporting you during illness while running alongside GitLab's additional sick time support.

Leave Entitlement & Key Details

**Sick Leave Entitlement:**

- **Eligibility:** 10 days statutory sick leave after 6 months continuous employment
- **Annual entitlement:** 10 days per 12-month period after meeting initial criteria
- **Carry over:** If in any year the team member doesn't meet the criteria, then they don't get any new sick leave entitlement, but can use their sick leave balance which may have carried over. An employee may re-qualify for sick leave as soon as they meet the criteria.
- **Maximum accumulation:** 20 days under New Zealand's Holidays Act 2003
- **Additional Support:** Runs concurrently with [GitLab's Sick Time Policy](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#sick-time)

**How to Apply:**

1. Contact leaves@gitlab.com when taking sick leave
2. Medical certificate may be required per Holidays Act
3. Select "Out Sick" in Workday for proper tracking
4. Unused sick leave is not paid out upon employment termination

[GitLab Canada Corp > We've Got You Covered > Time Away & Leave > Sick Leave]
**GitLab Canada Corp Entitlement**

- **Annual Allowance**: 10 days per year (3 days available after first month of employment)
- **Usage**: For illness, medical appointments, or caring for sick family members
- **Reporting**: Designate time as "Out Sick" in Workday for proper tracking

**Provincial Statutory Requirements**

- **Ontario**: 3 days job-protected unpaid sick leave (after 2+ weeks employment)
- **Quebec**: 2 days paid absence per calendar year

**Extended Sick Leave (5+ days)**

- GitLab supplements pay up to 100% of regular salary for up to 25 working days
- Additional 25 working days available for family care if not covered by provincial benefits
- Contact Absence Management team at leaves@domain.com
- Medical documentation may be required per local requirements

Provincial Leave Types and Request

Each province offers comprehensive leave entitlements including bereavement, family responsibility, critical illness, domestic violence, and specialized circumstances.

[GitLab PTY Ltd. Benefits - New Zealand > **GitLab PTY Ltd. Benefits - New Zealand** > **Time Away & Leave Policies** > **Injury Leave**]
Support during non-work accidents, with potential ACC coverage and GitLab top-up for extended injuries.

Coverage & Process

When the team member is taking leave for the first week of a non-work accident, they can use sick leave and/or annual leave if they have any. This leave runs concurrently with GitLab PTO/Sick Time.

**How to Apply:**

- Team members must notify the Absence Management team (leaves@gitlab.com) as soon as possible when they will need to go out on injured leave.
- Team members must designate time off for injury as Out Sick or Vacation in Workday if they wish to use sick leave or annual leave for the first week of an injury.
- If the leave will last longer than five days and is [covered by the Accident Compensation Corporation (ACC) scheme](https://www.acc.co.nz/im-injured/what-we-cover), GitLab will top up the ACC payment from 80 to 100% for the first 25 days.
